summary: Avalon at Mission Bay II, on the Assessor land parcel at 301 King St (blklot 8705011). The Assessor roll for that parcel shows 313 units and a 2006 year built, matching AvalonBay's Q4 2006 report of Avalon at Mission Bay North II, a 313-home high-rise completed that quarter (the release gives no street address, so the tie rests on the unit count).

milestones.text: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105249986 (17 stories, 301 King St) as completed on this date. A permit's completion date is not an opening date.

open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to carry Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source confirmed when re-read that day; fuller details recorded elsewhere in Pier & Point's data (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

The architect of this building is not confirmed: the Arquitectonica 'Avalon Mission Bay' page describes a 260-unit development that matches Avalon at Mission Bay North III, not this 313-unit building. The 'Avalon at Mission Bay II' name is Pier & Point's label; AvalonBay's releases call it 'Avalon at Mission Bay North II'.

The DBI permit for 301 King St (200105249986) is filed under block 3796, lot 003, not this record's parcel (8705/011), and lists 174 dwelling units where the Assessor roll lists 313. The address matches and the permit's completion (Oct 23, 2006) falls in the same year as the Assessor's year built (2006), but the unit-count difference is unresolved.
